question: In September 2024, the Uniform Code of Pharmaceutical Marketing Practices (UCPMP) 2024 extended its guidelines to which of the following sectors?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Medical device manufacturers**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• In September 2024, the Uniform Code of Pharmaceutical Marketing Practices (UCPMP) extended its guidelines to **medical device manufacturers** for ethical marketing and promotion practices.
 
• The UCPMP aims to regulate and ensure transparency in interactions between pharmaceutical companies and healthcare professionals, now including medical device manufacturers.
 
• The extension of UCPMP to medical device manufacturers highlights the growing importance of ethical considerations in the healthcare and medical device industry.
 
• Under these guidelines, medical device manufacturers are expected to adhere to ethical standards in advertising, promotions, and interactions with healthcare providers.
 
• This move aligns with the government's efforts to strengthen accountability and safeguard patient interests in the healthcare sector.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Uniform Code of Pharmaceutical Marketing Practices (UCPMP)**

 
 
• The UCPMP was introduced by the Department of Pharmaceuticals, Government of India, to regulate marketing practices in the pharmaceutical industry.
 
• It seeks to prevent unethical practices such as excessive gifts, inducements, or sponsorships offered to healthcare professionals.
 
• It emphasizes transparency, accountability, and ethical promotional practices in the healthcare sector.
 
 
 
• **Medical Devices Industry in India**
 
 
• India has one of the fastest-growing medical device markets globally, valued at approximately USD 11 billion in 2022.
 
• The sector is regulated by the Central Drugs Standard Control Organization (CDSCO) under the Drugs and Cosmetics Act.
 
• Medical devices range from diagnostic tools and surgical instruments to advanced imaging and therapeutic equipment.
 
 
 
• **Ethical Marketing Practices**
 
 
• Ethical marketing ensures that healthcare products are promoted in a manner that prioritizes patient welfare and safety.
 
• It includes accurate representation of product benefits, avoiding misleading claims, and transparent interactions with healthcare professionals.
 
 
 
• **Impact of UCPMP Extension**
 
 
• The inclusion of medical device manufacturers under UCPMP guidelines is expected to enhance trust among healthcare providers and patients.
 
• It promotes fair competition and deters unethical practices within the medical device industry.
